risks.risk: Structural dependence on Honeywell affiliates and the ultimate holding company
risks.note: A significant portion of sales and profits comes from relationships with Honeywell affiliates (including the ultimate holding company); sustaining or enhancing this revenue depends on Honeywell-specific business decisions independent of its shareholding — e.g. changes in Honeywell's strategy on global sourcing (including from alternative sources Honeywell affiliates may acquire or develop), and the level/mix of Honeywell's business with the Company.

risks.risk: Competitive and pricing pressure from the Honeywell relationship
risks.note: The overall competitive landscape includes pricing pressure on goods/services sold to Honeywell, potential reductions in order volume, or shifts in the mix of orders/sales to Honeywell, creating exposure beyond the Company's own market position.

risks.risk: Geopolitical risk (Middle East and Russia-Ukraine conflicts)
risks.note: Ongoing conflicts have disrupted the global economy and supply chains/chokepoints, raising trading and logistics costs; India's energy and agriculture-linked sectors are seen as particularly exposed.

risks.risk: Oil/gas import dependency and inflation risk
risks.note: India imports ~90% of its oil and 50-60% of its gas requirement, with a projected oil & gas import bill of over $125 billion; elevated or volatile oil prices from geopolitical tension (Middle East, Russia-Ukraine) or supply constraints (e.g. LPG supply constraints in March 2026) threaten inflation and India's macroeconomic stability, an indirect risk to the Company's operating environment.

risks.risk: Global trade, tariff and supply-chain realignment risk
risks.note: Continuing tariff and counter-tariff policies and US-China tensions are forcing 'friend-shoring' and reassessment of trade relationships; the Company states it will continue to monitor the impact of global tariff changes and trade agreements on supply chains, import prices and currency volatility.

The Indian rupee came under sustained pressure through 2025, weakening from INR85 per USD to the INR92-95 per USD range, a currency risk relevant given the Company's export revenue and import-linked costs.

risks.risk: Dependence on retaining skilled talent and staying ahead on customer requirements
risks.note: Management flags developing and retaining employees/leaders with necessary expertise, and identifying emerging trends and customer requirements ahead of competitors, as critical performance factors for sustaining revenue and profit.

hero.oneLiner: Honeywell Automation India Limited (HAIL) is an integrated automation, industrial software and sustainability solutions provider, operating as both a domestic system integrator and a captive engineering-services/contract-manufacturing exporter for its parent Honeywell Technologies.

one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: Honeywell Automation India Limited (HAIL) is an integrated automation, industrial software and sustainability solutions provider, operating as both a domestic system integrator and a captive engineering-services/contract-manufacturing exporter for its parent Honeywell Technologies.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: The Company operates a single Ind-AS segment, "Automation and Control Systems", spanning Process Solutions and Products, Honeywell Building Solutions (including Building Management Systems), Honeywell Sensing Solutions, and an Exports business (engineering services and contract manufacturing for Honeywell affiliates). It serves discrete and process industries (oil & gas, refining, pulp & paper, chemicals & petrochemicals, pharma & life sciences, metals) as well as infrastructure end-markets (metros, airports, data centers, commercial buildings) from one manufacturing plant plus a network of national and international offices.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- HAIL Mauritius Limited — related party: Holding Company of HAIL, holding 75% of the Company's shares; participates in the Company's Business Responsibility initiatives through the ultimate holding company
- Honeywell International Inc. — related party: Ultimate Holding Company; related party for sale/purchase of goods and services and reimbursement of expenses in the ordinary course of business
- Honeywell Measurex (Ireland) Ltd. — related party: Fellow Subsidiary; related party for purchase of goods/services in the ordinary course of business
- Honeywell Middle East B.V. — related party: Fellow Subsidiary; related party for sale of goods/services including reimbursement of expenses in the ordinary course of business

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Process Solutions and Products:** equipment for monitoring and controlling process parameters (refineries, petrochemicals, metals, chemicals, specialty chemicals), Tank Gauging and Oil Terminal Automation Solutions
- **Honeywell Building Solutions:** Enterprise Building Integrator (EBI), airfield ground lighting systems, Visual Docking and Guiding Systems (VDGS), Navitas software
- **Building Management Systems:** building automation controllers, field devices and software solutions for HVAC and building management
- **Honeywell Sensing Solutions:** pressure switches, airflow sensors, humidity and temperature sensors, oxygen and breath sensors
- **Exports (Engineering Services & Contract Manufacturing):** basic and detailed engineering, application software development, project management and system integration services, contract-manufactured products and turnkey automation/control project solutions

end_markets.title: End Markets (RHP)
end_markets.body:
- Oil & gas and refining
- Pulp & paper
- Industrial power generation
- Chemicals & petrochemicals
- Biofuels
- Pharma & life sciences
- Metals, minerals & mining
- Infrastructure (metros, airports, commercial buildings, data centers, smart cities)
- Transportation (including EV)
- Healthcare / medical
- Defense & aerospace
- Domestic India (public and private sector customers across 33 states/UTs)
- Exports to Honeywell affiliates in 60 countries

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Infrastructure sector expected to grow in line with GDP at 7-9% CAGR till 2030, driven by PM Gati Shakti, Sagarmala, Bharatmala and UDAN, with continued investment in roads, ports, railways, metros, logistics parks, industrial cities and data centers
- India's manufacturing & industrial sector targeted to reach 25% of GDP by 2035 under the National Manufacturing Mission, supported by Make in India, Atmanirbhar Bharat and PLI schemes, and Industry 4.0 adoption (automation, AI, smart manufacturing) that automation companies are well placed to serve
- Manufacturing PMI dropped to 53.9 in March 2026, the lowest since June 2022, reflecting near-term headwinds from Middle East conflict-driven uncertainty, higher costs, supply chain shocks and moderating demand
- Robust energy demand growth expected (6-6.5% per annum, 2025-2030) with sustained push toward renewables (solar, wind), green hydrogen, carbon capture (CCUS) and EVs, creating opportunities for automation and monitoring solutions
- Domestic market opportunities expected to continue growing on infrastructure investment, energy transition, new energy investments (alternate energy, giga factories) and advanced manufacturing (semiconductor, pharma), aided by Make in India and PLI policies
- Honeywell Building Solutions growth to be driven by increased government funding for critical infrastructure (airports, railways, hospitals) and rising private investment in data centers, semiconductor facilities, Li-ion battery manufacturing and solar panel production
- Export/captive business poised to benefit as parent Honeywell Inc has substantially completed its portfolio transformation into Honeywell Technologies, a focused pure-play automation company, though global markets remain exposed to visa dynamics, tariffs, preference for local manufacturing and free trade agreement shifts
- Building Management Systems reported robust pipeline expansion as part of its commercial-excellence initiatives during the year

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Solidify position around the megatrends of Sustainability, Automation and Digitalization, addressing both local demand of Indian industry and global demand of parent Honeywell Technologies as a captive provider
- Maintain growth trajectory targeting 2x GDP growth while balancing profit rate, portfolio mix and working capital discipline
- As system integrator of the parent, monetize the installed base by deploying connected offerings that drive asset efficiency, sustainability and energy-efficiency outcomes
- Lead the journey 'from Automation to Autonomy' enabled by digitalization and intelligent automation applications
- Pivot connected offerings towards an annual recurring revenue model, and build capability in applied physical AI
- Process Solutions: continue focus on creating an at-scale install base to drive lifecycle value; pursue growth levers of digitization, sustainability and tailwinds in metals, life sciences, pharmaceuticals and gas; grow software solutions such as cybersecurity; expand reach into the renewable energy market
- Honeywell Building Solutions: align with market trends in advanced manufacturing, infrastructure and data centers, leveraging automation and control technologies for system integration
- Building Management Systems: pursue commercial excellence (sales deployment, onboarding, channel partner excellence, pipeline expansion, new product launches) and target high-growth sectors (healthcare, data centers, government infrastructure) via Connected Buildings initiatives
- Honeywell Sensing Solutions: expand defense & military product portfolio into new government programs; expand channel footprint; rationalize portfolio to prioritize right technologies and future customer demand
- Exports: sustain an asset-light engineering-services and contract-manufacturing model prioritizing high asset turnover, operational agility and a variable cost structure; continue strategic investment in new product development, automation, capacity enhancement and localization to improve cost competitiveness and delivery
- Commitment to achieving carbon neutrality by 2035 as part of a holistic growth and climate strategy
- The Company has formulated a Dividend Distribution Policy in compliance with Regulation 43A of the SEBI Listing Regulations (available on the Company's website), and dividend recommendations by the Board are made in compliance with this policy. Independent Directors are compensated through sitting fees and commission within Shareholder-approved limits, while Non-Executive Non-Independent Directors receive neither sitting fees nor commission, as a matter of policy.

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: No single named capex project with a commissioning/completion timeline is disclosed. Expansion is described qualitatively: Process Solutions continues to expand its reach into underpenetrated geographies within India through OEM engagements and is enhancing its reach and coverage to serve the renewable energy market with new solutions; Honeywell Building Solutions is aligning with growth in advanced manufacturing, infrastructure, data centers, semiconductor facilities, Li-ion battery manufacturing and solar panel production; Building Management Systems is expanding channel partner reach and sales pipeline; the asset-light Exports (engineering services & contract manufacturing) business continues strategic investment in new product development, automation, capacity enhancement and localization to improve cost competitiveness and delivery performance.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Captive engineering-services and contract-manufacturing relationship with Honeywell affiliates (asset-light model, high asset turnover, variable cost structure) that underpins the Exports business
- Core strategy of building an at-scale installed base in Process Solutions to drive recurring lifecycle-services value and customer switching costs
- Broad, diversified product and end-market reach spanning process industries and building/infrastructure automation, reducing single-sector dependence
- Positioned as the domestic system integrator of a global, focused pure-play automation parent (Honeywell Technologies), giving access to global technology and brand
